about_the_game:
8 Original background music tracks featured in Burn Zombie Burn written by Ian Livingstone.

Also as a bonus, included are a Burn Zombie Burn! Comic and a Guide available in English, German, Spanish, French, and Italian!

Burn Zombie Burn Tracks


1. Blazing Stiffs
2. Blood Bath
3. Burn Zombie Burn
4. Burning Hell
5. Hacking Evil
6. Passage of Darkness
7. Smolder Shoulder
8. Zombification

Sound files: MP3, 320Kbs, 44.1kHz, Stereo

Songs will be placed in your Burn Zombie Burn! folder in the Steam Directory: ...Steam\steamapps\common\burn zombie burn!\Soundtrack_and_Comic
